formattedAddress: No. 16之2號, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan N Rd, Kangle Village, Zhongshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 104

text.text:
Updates: we came here again with 3 of us. This time, we got a bigger table and ordered their meal set for 3~4 people. We almost cleaned all the plates and foods were so delicious! Highly recommended ordering this set or just follow our photos to order the dishes. Those are the best!

This Izakaya 🏮 is under ABV chain restaurant and mixed with a bit American beer 🍺 bar style! This Izakaya is just right across a 5-star hotel in Zhongshan Dist. I’ve visited here many times and never got wrong with their signatures!
